generate_batch_id: generate a unique timestamp-based batch ID for a HITL run
deregister_dashboard_subdomain: deregister all CloudFlare DNS subdomains matching a batch ID on craftassist.io
dedup_commands: deduplicate a list of commands by removing case-insensitive repeated entries
examine_hit: examine all submitted assignments for a given MTurk HIT ID
delete_all_mturk_hits: delete all MTurk HITs from the sandbox account by expiring and removing them
